translation.text: And at the end of four years[a], Absalom said to the king, “Please let me go and pay the vow that I vowed to the LORD in Hebron.”

footnotes.text: This proposal reads “four years,” as in some Greek witnesses, selected Syriac and Latin, and Josephus's retelling. The Masoretic Hebrew, selected Greek texts and a contrary Latin edition read “forty years.” The edited Qumran numerals are restorations, not surviving letters. The Hebrew does not state when the interval began; earliest wording remains uncertain.
